# MyCampusKorner

> MyCampusKorner (mycampuskorner.com) is a college shopping guide for US students and their parents. It gathers hand-picked dorm, classroom, tech, travel, money and wellness picks in one place, sorted into simple categories, so a family can cross off a move-in list without endless tab-switching. Built by a college parent in Ann Arbor, Michigan. The blog adds practical campus advice: "Real campus advice. No retail bias."

Who it is for: incoming and current college students, and parents shopping for move-in day. Products link to the retailers that sell them; some links are affiliate links, which earn the site a commission at no extra cost to the buyer (see the disclosure on every page). Contact: support@mycampuskorner.com.

## Shop by category

- [Dorm & Living Essentials](https://mycampuskorner.com/category?id=dorm-living-essentials): Turn a bare dorm room into a place that feels like home. Bedding, storage, lighting and the small organizers that make a shared room work, picked for tight spaces and a smooth move-in day.
- [Academic Essentials](https://mycampuskorner.com/category?id=academic-essentials): Secure the precise study setups required to crush your specific major. From workspace organization and high-quality writing instruments to STEM-ready graphing calculators and capable, budget-friendly tech options.
- [Personal Lifestyle](https://mycampuskorner.com/category?id=personal-lifestyle): The everyday gear that keeps campus life running, from headphones and bags to self-care basics, chosen with a student budget in mind.
- [Travel & Entertainment](https://mycampuskorner.com/category?id=event-tickets-travel): Game days, concerts and weekend trips: tickets, travel gear and ways to get around, so getting home and getting out is one less thing to plan.
- [Financial Services](https://mycampuskorner.com/category?id=financial-services): Student-friendly banking, budgeting and money tools for managing your own finances, often for the first time.
- [Health & Fitness](https://mycampuskorner.com/category?id=health-fitness): Stay active between classes and keep your energy up through finals: workout gear, running shoes, recovery and wellness picks that fit a student budget and a small dorm.
- [Every product](https://mycampuskorner.com/store): the whole catalog, with search and filters
